sections.title: How the Jeevan Anand Calculator Works

content.text: Our calculator demystifies the returns of Plan 715 by applying LIC's standard calculation methodology. This jeevan anand maturity calculator with fab combines guaranteed benefits with non-guaranteed bonuses to project your final payout.

Maturity formula (SA + Vested Bonus × years + FAB)

The core of the calculation lies in this formula:

Maturity Value = Sum Assured + Vested Bonuses + Final Additional Bonus (FAB)

A worked example: For a ₹10 Lakh policy over 25 years with a bonus rate of ₹45 and FAB of ₹100 per ₹1000 SA:

  • Sum Assured: ₹10,00,000
  • Vested Bonus: (10,00,000 / 1000) * 45 * 25 = ₹11,25,000
  • FAB: (10,00,000 / 1000) * 100 = ₹1,00,000
  • Total: ₹10,00,000 + ₹11,25,000 + ₹1,00,000 = ₹22,25,000

Where we get bonus & FAB numbers

Bonuses are not guaranteed. Our calculator uses illustrative rates from official LIC bonus declarations and industry analysis. For official figures, always refer to the LIC New Jeevan Anand brochure.

sections.title: Inputs Explained: DOB, Sum Assured, Term, Premium, Bonus per ₹1,000, FAB

items: Age & Term: Your entry age and the policy term are the primary factors that determine the premium rate.
Sum Assured: The guaranteed amount you receive at maturity, before bonuses. This is key for calculating your lic jeevan anand 10 lakh premium maturity.
Bonus per ₹1,000: The Simple Reversionary Bonus rate. An illustrative rate of ₹40-₹49 is typical.
Final Additional Bonus (FAB): A loyalty bonus for long-term policies, also calculated per ₹1,000 SA. Can be left at 0 if unsure.

content.text: If you stop paying premiums after 2 full years, the policy doesn't lapse but continues with reduced benefits. Our Jeevan Anand paid up value calculator and surrender value calculator logic provides the following estimates:

items: Paid-Up Value: Your Sum Assured is reduced proportionately. Formula: `Paid-up SA = Basic SA × (Premiums Paid / Total Premiums Payable)`. You receive this reduced SA plus vested bonuses at maturity.
Guaranteed Surrender Value (GSV): A percentage of total premiums paid plus a percentage of vested bonuses.

Special Surrender Value (SSV): This is typically what LIC pays out. Our calculator provides an estimate for this, which is essential for understanding your Jeevan Anand surrender value after 5 years or more.

content.title: Example: Surrender value after 5 years
content.text: For a ₹10L, 25-year policy, if you stop paying after 5 years (total premium paid ~₹2.25L), your estimated surrender value (SSV) would be around ₹1.5 Lakh. However, the Paid-up value at maturity would be significantly higher. It's often better to make the policy paid-up than to surrender.

items.q: What is the LIC Jeevan Anand maturity formula?
items.a: Maturity = Sum Assured + (Vested Simple Reversionary Bonus × Policy Term) + Final Additional Bonus (if declared). Use the calculator with the bonus/FAB inputs for estimates.

items.q: How to use the LIC Jeevan Anand calculator (Plan 715)?
items.a: Simply enter your age, desired Sum Assured, and policy term. The calculator will instantly estimate your premium, maturity benefits, and provide a detailed breakdown.

items.q: How accurate is an online Jeevan Anand calculator?
items.a: It’s an estimate — accurate when you input the correct bonus/FAB and premium. Actual maturity is determined by LIC and depends on final declared bonuses and underwriting.

items.q: When does Jeevan Anand get surrender value?
items.a: Typically after 2 full years of premiums. Eligibility and rates vary by plan; our calculator shows GSV & SSV estimates based on years paid.

items.q: Is Jeevan Anand maturity taxable under Section 10(10D)?
items.a: Generally tax-free, but conditions apply (eg. premium rules). Always check exact tax treatment for your case or consult a tax advisor.

items.q: Should I surrender or make my policy paid-up?
items.a: Paid-up often gives higher final benefits (for long-term policies) — surrender gives immediate cash. Use the calculator’s paid-up vs surrender comparison to decide.

items.q: Can NRIs buy Jeevan Anand and use this calculator?
items.a: NRIs can use the calculator; actual purchase and eligibility depend on LIC rules and FEMA regulations — check with LIC/agent.

items.q: How does adding riders affect maturity?
items.a: Riders increase premium but usually don’t increase the maturity sum assured; rider benefits are paid separately in case of covered events.

items.q: Can I take a loan against my Jeevan Anand policy?
items.a: Yes — loans are generally available after the policy acquires surrender value. Typical loan amount is up to 80–90% of the SSV.

items.q: What documents are needed to surrender a Jeevan Anand policy?
items.a: Policy bond, identity proof, bank details, surrender form and discharge form (subject to LIC’s updated requirements).

items.q: what is survival benefit in lic jeevan anand
items.a: Unlike a money-back plan, Jeevan Anand (915) does not have periodic 'survival benefits'. The main payout is the lump sum at the end of the policy term. However, the life cover continues even after maturity, which is a unique feature.

items.q: how to change nominee in lic jeevan anand online
items.a: Currently, changing the nominee for an LIC policy is an offline process. You need to fill out the 'Nominee Change Form' and submit it at your servicing LIC branch along with a copy of your policy and KYC documents.

items.q: what is policy term in lic jeevan anand
items.a: The policy term is the duration for which you pay premiums and are covered for the primary benefits. For Plan 715, it can range from 15 to 35 years. A unique feature is that the life cover (equal to the Sum Assured) continues even after the policy term, until the policyholder's death.
